ba Attempt any two parts (5*2=10)

Explain a model which ensures the same.
b) To create a banking application, which software development life cycle
model! will you use and why? Explain the model in detail.

O38 Attempt any two parts (5*2=10)

flows, data stores, processes, draw upto 2 level Data Flow Diagram.
b) Draw Use Case Diagram for Online Food Ordering System.

with its different types.
